arguments.notes:
DATABASE: PostgreSQL (not SQLite; sqlite_master does not exist). Schema public. Table names are case-sensitive and must be double-quoted uppercase (e.g. "APINVH").

TABLES (row counts at time of exploration):
- APINVH (804) – AP invoice header: INV_ID int PK, VEND_CD char (space padded), INV_NO text (vendor invoice no.), INV_DT int YYYYMMDD, INV_AMT numeric, STAT_CD char, JRNL_NO int.
- APPAYM (508) – AP payments: PAY_ID int PK, INV_ID int, PAY_DT int YYYYMMDD, PAY_AMT numeric.
- APVEND (24) – vendor master: VEND_CD char(8 padded) PK, VEND_NM text, ACTV_FLG char.
- GLCOA (10) – chart of accounts: ACCT_CD char(8 padded), ACCT_NM text, ACCT_TYP text, ACTV_FLG char.
- GLJRNH (1464) – journal headers: JRNL_NO int PK, PRD_ID int, POST_DT int YYYYMMDD, POST_FLG char, REF_JRNL_NO int, SRC_CD char, SRC_REF text, MEMO text.
- GLJRNL (3502) – journal lines: (JRNL_NO, LN_SEQ) composite key, ACCT_CD char, DR_AMT numeric, CR_AMT numeric.
- GLPERD (12) – fiscal periods: PRD_ID int PK, STRT_DT, END_DT, CLOSE_DT (int YYYYMMDD, NULL when open), STAT_CD char.
- SYSDICT (TBL_NM, COL_NM, DESCR) – a data dictionary table. Quoted name "SYSDICT". Covers APINVH, APPAYM, APVEND, GLCOA, GLJRNH, GLJRNL, GLPERD but NOT the dictionary itself and no entries for REF_JRNL_NO or LN_SEQ is listed only partially (LN_SEQ and REF_JRNL_NO are absent or unclear; verify).

RELATIONSHIPS (none declared as constraints; inferred from column names and data):
- APINVH.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (invoice journal). Confirmed: 1000 maps to 1000 with matching INV_AMT context.
- APPAYM.INV_ID -> APINVH.INV_ID. Payments are separate GLJRNH entries (SRC_CD 'AP', SRC_REF 'PAY-n', MEMO 'Payment <invoice no>') that do NOT have an APINVH row; payment journal linkage to APPAYM is not via JRNL_NO in the sampled rows (not verified further).
- GLJRNL.JRNL_NO -> GLJRNH.JRNL_NO (header/line). Every header has lines; no orphan lines checked explicitly beyond header existence (0 headers without lines).
- GLJRNL.ACCT_CD -> GLCOA.ACCT_CD.
- GLJRNH.PRD_ID -> GLPERD.PRD_ID.
- APINVH.VEND_CD -> APVEND.VEND_CD.
- GLJRNH.REF_JRNL_NO: appears NULL in sampled rows; purpose unknown (possibly reversal/reference journal).

CONVENTIONS:
- Dates are integers YYYYMMDD (not date types). Use range comparisons.
- Amounts are unsigned numerics: DR_AMT and CR_AMT are both non-negative and each line uses one side only (0 rows with both nonzero, 0 negatives). Sign is expressed by which column is populated, not by sign.
- Codes: APINVH.STAT_CD O=open, P=paid, V=void (V not observed in data). GLJRNH.POST_FLG P=posted, U=unposted (only P observed). GLJRNH.SRC_CD AP / GL. GLPERD.STAT_CD O/C. ACCT_TYP ASSET/LIABILITY/EXPENSE (dictionary says only these three; observed counts 2/2/6 with no REVENUE or EQUITY accounts in the chart, which is suspicious for a complete CoA). ACTV_FLG and ACTV_FLG Y/N.
- Char columns are space-padded fixed-width; compare with trimming.
- SRC_REF on GL journals holds the keying user name per the dictionary, but on AP journals it holds the invoice number or 'PAY-n' reference, so the dictionary description is inconsistent with the data.

DATA QUALITY / SUSPICIOUS ITEMS FOUND:
1. Journal 1364 is out of balance: SUM(DR)-SUM(CR) = -9.00. Unbalanced journal.
2. Invoice 802 has a negative INV_AMT (-207.62) with STAT_CD 'O', contrary to the apparent convention of positive invoice totals.
3. Payment 421: APPAYM total 5248.89 vs APINVH.INV_AMT 5248.88 (1 cent difference).
4. Journal 2459 is assigned PRD_ID 2 but POST_DT 20240319, which falls in period 3 (March 2024); period/date mismatch.
5. Invoice STAT_CD: 296 open, 508 paid, no voids. Paid invoices all have payments; no open invoice has payments.
6. Periods 1-10 closed, 11 and 12 open; CLOSE_DT NULL for open periods. Posting into closed periods was not tested.
7. SYSDICT documentation is incomplete (missing dictionary entries for some columns, e.g. REF_JRNL_NO, and no entry for SYSDICT itself) and some descriptions conflict with the data (SRC_REF meaning). Treat it as a starting point only, verified claims are noted above.
8. Only 24 vendors and 10 accounts: a small, possibly sample/test dataset; the CoA lacks revenue/equity accounts.

Not yet examined: full referential integrity of APPAYM to GLJRNH, REF_JRNL_NO usage, LN_SEQ continuity, invoice-to-journal amount agreement, and whether voided/reversed entries exist.
